test_title: PYST 25: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 20th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Statements: All singers are performers. No performer is boring.

Conclusions: I. No singer is boring.

Conclusions: II. Some singers are boring.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc6d23a7868922
ea347d12af76eaede5358a4585dfa9ee658e5a785089869f45.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/420cdce90b4b53521fbd722107c8cfcf473db03a0cfcd4c6fa379e9408585a19.png] 

Conclusions: I. No singer is boring → True( As, All singers are performers. No performer is boring. So, No singer is boring holds true)

Conclusions: II. Some singers are boring → False (As, All singers are performers. No performer is boring. So, Some singers are boring cannot be true)

Thus, Only I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
